Gemini API changelog | Google AI for Developers

notes: Could not confirm a model with the exact id 'gemini-3.5-transcribe-preview'. Google's Gemini API models page and changelog document 'gemini-3.5-transcribe' (stable/GA, released August 26, 2026: non-streaming speech-to-text with utterance-based language detection, diarization and word timestamps) and 'gemini-3.5-transcribe-live' (streaming variant), and the changelog states these are the first dedicated speech-to-text models in the Gemini 3.5 generation with no earlier preview phase documented. Vertex AI doc URLs guessed for a '-preview' variant of this model returned 404, and web search for the exact id found nothing. Since I cannot confirm whether this catalog id is the same model as the GA 'gemini-3.5-transcribe', an earlier undocumented Vertex-only preview snapshot, or something else, I am not describing it rather than guess.
